edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC5 Each business rule BR1 to BR10 holds (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8 are in the build
    When the component and boundary tests run
    Then each rule answers as its row in section 8 states and no rule is left without a test

  Scenario: AC6 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 of the provided operations match the contract (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to a provided operation carries no valid credential, a role without the right, or names a missing case or legal action
    When the operation answers
    Then it answers 401, 403 or 404 as the contract states and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC7 A replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key writes once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write has been accepted with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same request is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the replay writes nothing new, sends no second instruction and returns the stored answer

  Scenario: AC8 A retried or timed-out activity writes once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an activity of LitigationWorkflow is retried or exceeds its timeout
    When the activity runs again
    Then the step writes no duplicate row and sends no duplicate instruction, and the workflow keeps its durable state

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer is refused with 503 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed contract does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the step calls it
    Then the answer is 503 with the platform error envelope, nothing is written and the caller repeats the same Idempotency-Key

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the legal action is in a status from which the requested change is not allowed by the model
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused, nothing is written and no instruction is sent
